options.name: backend
options.description: Backend storage configuration for the repository. Required if O(state=created), O(state=connected), or O(state=synced).

options.name: config
options.description: Path to the Kopia config file for this repository connection. Defaults to the Kopia default config path when not set.

options.name: fingerprint_tls
options.description: TLS certificate fingerprint of the Kopia server. Required if O(state=connected) and O(backend.provider=server).

options.name: password
options.description: Repository password used to encrypt and decrypt repository contents.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the Kopia repository.

options.name: throttle
options.description: Throttle limits for the repository connection. Only used when O(state=throttled).

options.name: url
options.description: URL of the Kopia server to connect to. Required if O(state=connected) and O(backend.provider=server).
